title: The Sun
sub: Complete notes on ASAP Ep. 2 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. The Sun as the astral body's source, a full body-map of the planets, the Sun through all twelve signs, personal protective deities, and ritual as a kind of hypnosis.
desc: Complete notes on ASAP Ep. 2, The Sun by Brajesh Gautam: the astral body, the Sun through every sign, Ishta (personal protective deity), why ritual works, and a worked chart example, with video timestamps.
points: Diet and timing matter far less than whether your inner energy body is settled.
Every organ maps to a planet.
Skull, eyes, liver, navel and spine each belong to one of the nine (plus outer) grahas.
The Sun changes character in every sign.
A king visiting a friendly house rules well; visiting a hostile one, it gets drained or destructive.
You may already have a protective deity (Ishta).
It runs automatically; the only real task is avoiding the opposing one's domain.
Ritual is one way to flip a cosmic switch.
Some paths are direct, some are long; neither route is more spiritually advanced.
Respect for elders strengthens the Sun.
Touching their feet, even through private resentment, reshapes a person's own habits over time.
A high energy state does not guarantee bodily ease; the speaker argues for a middle path over either extreme.
